description_en: Deletes an application from a Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) cluster
description_zh: 调用DeleteK8sApplication接口删除容器服务K8s应用
name: DeleteK8sApplication

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application that you want to delete. You can call the ListApplication operation to query the application ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to forcibly delete the application and disable application deletion protection
parameters.help_zh: 是否强制删除应用，跳过应用删除保护
parameters.name: force

ChangeOrderId.description_en: The ID of the change process for this operation. If an instance on which the application is deployed is running or a Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance is bound to the application, this operation generates a change process ID and deletes the application. You can call the GetChangeOrderInfo operation to query the progress of this operation. You can determine whether the operation is successful based on the value of the Code parameter
ChangeOrderId.description_zh: 如果被删除应用有机器没有下线，或者SLB未解绑，此时会生成变更流程ID，并进行删除。调用GetChangeOrderInfo接口获取这次删除具体执行进展。根据Code判断是否删除成功

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code that is returned

Message.description_en: The additional information that is returned
